title: Wayfare Pass Priority Pickup Upgrade Credit — Desk Guidance
content:
# Priority Pickup upgrade credit — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

## Rule the desk applies

On a move up to Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly, the Priority Pickup upgrade credit counts the Priority Pickup charges the member paid in the last three months: 2.00 at 3 or more, 1.00 at 1 or 2, nothing at none. The credit is a flat amount subtracted from the Plus Monthly upgrade charge; the charge never goes below 0.00 and is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## What is counted

Priority Pickup charges on the member's trips in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) dated in the last three months. A Priority Pickup that was waived as a Pass benefit is a waiver, not a charge the member paid, and is not counted.

## Points of judgement

| Priority Pickup charges paid in the last three months | Credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 2.00 |
| 1 or 2 | 1.00 |
| none | nothing |

- 3 charges: 2.00; 2 charges: 1.00.
- 1 charge: 1.00; 0 charges: nothing.

Hypothetically, a member with five Priority Pickup charges and two Priority Pickup waivers in the last three months counts 5 charges and has 2.00 subtracted.
